facts.fact: 事后场景：Lucy 摊在沙发上，Saskia 从她两腿之间抬起头笑。
facts.anchor: Saskia looks up from between her thighs and grins

facts.fact: Saskia 起身去冰箱倒柠檬水，从躺在地上的 Roger 身边走过而完全不看他。
facts.anchor: Saskia levers herself off the couch and pads across the room, ignoring Roger

facts.fact: Lucy 淋浴时回想：Roger 一断气就只剩下一件碍事的东西。
facts.anchor: As soon as Roger was dead, he was just a thing, an annoyance.

facts.fact: Saskia 自白：办公室改成居家办公那天，她顺手带走了没人管的将死植物。
facts.anchor: I stole a dying plant that everyone else had forgotten.

facts.fact: 她给这株 Monstera 起名叫 Monique。
前房客 Greg 从后门挤进她的公寓。
facts.anchor: he pushed past me into my apartment—came in through the back door

facts.fact: 被压在厨房操作台边时，她伸手去抓手边第一件东西。
facts.anchor: I reached for the first thing I could find

facts.fact: 她埋了 Greg，在他上面砌起菜畦，把土全部盖过并种满植物。
facts.anchor: I buried him, and I built raised beds over him, over everything, and I filled them with plants

facts.fact: 她说这些作物长得疯，因为他是极好的肥料。
她收到通知：同一单元里住着一个登记在案的性犯罪者。
facts.anchor: a registered sex offender lived in the unit

facts.fact: 她在 Nate 卧室外听见一段录音，是小女孩的声音，叫他 Uncle Nate。
facts.anchor: A recording of a little girl’s voice, calling him Uncle Nate

facts.fact: 黑暗中他冲过来，正好撞上她手里那把刀。
她把 Nate 的尸体从 Lucy 的后窗扔出去，落在院子里。
facts.anchor: I just chucked him out your back window, and he fell onto the patio

facts.fact: 结尾 Lucy 贴着她耳边说：也许我也很危险。
